$comment: Public, tenant-independent Microsoft Entra / Microsoft Graph constant identifiers referenced by the identity/ demo artifacts and their validators. None of these values are tenant-specific, secret, or customer-specific; they are documented, built-in identifiers that are identical in every Microsoft Entra tenant.

authenticationContextClassReferenceIds.$comment: Microsoft Graph authenticationContextClassReferences use fixed, tenant-independent 'c1'..'c25' ids; only the displayName/description that a tenant admin assigns to each id in Entra ID > Conditional Access > Authentication context is tenant-specific (and is intentionally not recorded here). 'c1' is this repository's own documented demo convention for 'PIM privileged-role activation', shared by identity/pim/*.template.json's activation.authenticationContext and identity/conditional-access/ca-pim-activation-mfa.template.json's conditions.applications.includeAuthenticationContextClassReferences so the two artifact types reference the same Graph-compatible claim value.
